purpose: Inventory and evidence discovery only. No live geometry, survey, per-property insurance outcome, or county-level event damage established.

events.title: January–February 1937 Ohio–Mississippi River flood
events.notice: Pre-NFIP 1937 event: FEMA and NFIP did not yet exist; modern FIRM/BFE and footprints are retrospective reconstruction only.

events.title: 2011 Ohio–Wabash flood regional research context
events.notice: 2011 event window is for index/discovery only; exact local flood onset/crest and which agency maps were used must be independently documented.

map_editions.evidence_origin: TSM reviewed historical panel photograph noted in docs/evidence/POSEY-POINT-TOWNSHIP-HISTORICAL-SOURCE-RECONCILIATION.md

sources.construction_method: Agency Flood Insurance Study, panel revisions and effective map editions; retrieve panel-specific engineering source documentation
sources.quality_basis: Panel effective date, map scale, FIS hydrology/hydraulics, flood zone, BFE, datum, PMR/LOMC and FIRM revision chronology need product-specific review

sources.construction_method: Digital effective FIRM database and map revisions; current service is not an archive of past effective states
sources.quality_basis: Product-specific FIRM panel, DFIRM_ID, zone, SFHA, FIS, source_date, BFE and revision

sources.construction_method: Redacted policy/claims administrative records; use bounded existing TSM OpenFEMA v3 adapter and aggregate allowed geography/time
sources.quality_basis: Record coverage, loss-date, source refresh, suppression, aggregation and redaction; NOT a regulatory map

sources.construction_method: Federal administrative incident/declaration summaries; incident time and declaration time must be distinguished
sources.quality_basis: Disaster identifier, affected designated area, declaration/incident dates and FEMA query receipts

sources.construction_method: 1937 flood documentation: stage/discharge records, peak measurements and hydrologic reporting
sources.quality_basis: Gage identifiers, historical records, publication date, original measurement method and uncertainty

sources.construction_method: USGS event-related high-water marks, instruments, surveys and sensors
sources.quality_basis: Event and survey identifiers, survey methods, HWM quality, dates, coordinates, vertical datum and uncertainty

sources.construction_method: 2012 USGS Ohio River backwater flood inundation analysis for Saline and Wabash Rivers in southern Illinois; stage-conditioned mapped simulations
sources.quality_basis: Study gage 03381700, simulated stages, hydraulic model inputs, DEM/bathymetry, model calibration and 2014 revised publication

sources.construction_method: USGS water observations including stage and discharge; preserve site, time, parameter, approval status and gauge datum
sources.quality_basis: Site ID, USGS parameter/statistic, QA approval, stage datum correction and observation temporal coverage

sources.construction_method: NWS forecast, observations, crest history and flood impact information; NOT general historical daily time series
sources.quality_basis: Station ID, forecast issuance, observation time, rating/categorical thresholds; historic crest only

sources.construction_method: Indiana lidar classifications and derivative DEM, DSM, NDHM; public AWS bucket giselevationingov; capture tile-level metadata
sources.quality_basis: LiDAR collection date, QL, point density, vertical RMSEz, LAS class, raster resolution, datum and geoid

sources.construction_method: Published service maps statewide individual lidar collection dates and tile grids
sources.quality_basis: Tile id, GPS acquisition date, county-year aggregation and quality context

sources.construction_method: State Best Available Floodplain and site-specific floodplain information; distinguish planning product from effective NFHL
sources.quality_basis: Study/model origin, mapping version, data date, BFE/vertical datum and source authority

sources.construction_method: KyFromAbove catalog STAC tile references for point clouds, bare earth DEM and orthophotography
sources.quality_basis: STAC asset ID, acquisition phase/date, LiDAR QL, contractor QA, CRS, datum, resolution and vertical RMSEz

sources.construction_method: State source discovery for statewide parcel, structures, hydrography and imagery layers
sources.quality_basis: Individual service/item metadata, data steward, vintage, classification accuracy and identifiers

sources.construction_method: Illinois geospatial LiDAR tile products with acquisition and local metadata
sources.quality_basis: Tile collection year, density, horizontal and vertical accuracy, vertical units/datum

sources.construction_method: Statewide Microsoft/Bing-derived footprints and LiDAR LAS class 6/LP360 derived shapes in selected counties; distinguish methods
sources.quality_basis: Producer/license, imagery versus LiDAR class-6 method, county acquisition date, polygons and topology; Gallatin class-6 2012 documented

sources.construction_method: Illinois mapping project, county FEMA effective FIRM and Flood Insurance Study discovery
sources.quality_basis: Panel revision, FEMA MSC link, risk review status and evidence that map was effective for event

limitations: Current NFHL geometry is not a verified historical map snapshot.
NFIP claims/policies are administrative context, cannot be joined to individual buildings, addresses, or parcels from public redacted data.
USGS model-based inundation maps are not FEMA BFE determinations and do not by themselves prove maps used during an event.
Modern 2012–2026 LiDAR and building footprints are post-event for 1937, often for 2011; preserve acquisition vintage.
No 1937 parcel-level BFE or regulatory NFIP panel can have existed; FEMA/NFIP was established decades later.
No source tile checksum, digital map edition or asset geometry is attached to this inventory.
